value.title: Episode 1
value.synopsis: Business has slowed for Nozomu at Rainy Color's new Hawaii branch. Maybe a new shop dog will turn things around?

value.title: Episode 2
value.synopsis: The new shop dog, Nana, arrives. This cute Shiba Inu has a hidden talent!

value.title: Episode 3
value.synopsis: Rainy Color has a new regular with a very discerning taste in coffee.

value.title: Episode 4
value.synopsis: Nozomu has to go searching for Nana after she goes missing.

value.title: Episode 5
value.synopsis: Nozomu stumbles upon the legendary Kau coffee, and Nana meets a new friend.

value.title: Episode 6
value.synopsis: Ando and Chipper take Nozomu out to help him realize what his coffee is lacking.

value.title: Episode 7
value.synopsis: Nozomu consults with a stationery store owner for ideas about how to boost business at the cafe.

value.title: Episode 8
value.synopsis: Nozomu runs the Honolulu Marathon and makes a new friend.

value.title: Episode 9
value.synopsis: Curt has a new proposal to help Nozomu advertise his cafe.

value.title: Episode 10
value.synopsis: Nozomu meets the owner of Kawaii Kon and consults with a Japanese producer about an anime to show at their booth.

value.title: Episode 11
value.synopsis: Nozomu and Curt arrive at Kawaii Kon with anime and coffee in tow.

value.title: Episode 12
value.synopsis: After the success of Kawaii Kon, a few of the celebrity guests join Nozomu and his friends at his cafe.
